title: Sidestep, Then Back Rank
setup: Black's king on f8 is hemmed in by its own crowd, and your queen on g6 is already close enough to check it.
hint: Push the king to the one square its own pieces leave it, then hit the rank it can no longer leave.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Qh6+}} checks along the h6–f8 diagonal and drives the king to g8: {{Kg8}} is the only move. Then {{Re8#}}. The queen keeps g7, the rook's own line through the king takes f8 and h8, the h7 pawn fills the rest, and nothing can take the rook.
